protocol.clock_rule: binary64-rounded tau / minimum accessible-gap midpoint at finest certificate
protocol.window_reporting: retain every adjacent pair and all common qualifying pairs at finest grid and tighter tolerance; no result-dependent extension

protocol.failure_rule: retain every requested rung and tolerance; no finest-failure fallback; preserve partial evidence; insufficient precision is unresolved; failed controls or source/accounting drift invalidate success

failure_rules.source_or_dependency_drift: stop new target work and invalidate qualification
failure_rules.unresolved: retain at fixed caps; never replace with zero or a gap-collapse claim
failure_rules.post_result_changes: no budget widening, schedule extension or additional refinement
failure_rules.controls: failed required preflight prevents every target attempt
failure_rules.verification: replay every cell before qualification; retain invalid evidence as failure
